<!-- Generated by `bun run docs:reference` from seek's definitions. Do not edit. -->

Turn any live URL into clean, structured Markdown, HTML, JSON, summary, or screenshot via Firecrawl v2.

Part of [`seek scrape`](seek-scrape.md).

## Usage

```text
seek scrape firecrawl [options] <url>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Yes | URL to scrape |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-f, --format <formats>` | Comma-separated formats: markdown,html,rawHtml,links,summary,screenshot,video,audio | `"markdown"` |
| `--json-prompt <text>` | Add a JSON format with this LLM extraction prompt (produces data.json) |  |
| `--full` | Include nav/footer/sidebars (disables onlyMainContent) | `false` |
| `--wait <ms>` | Wait N ms for JS to render before scraping |  |
| `--mobile` | Render as a mobile viewport | `false` |
| `--block-ads` | Block ads / trackers during render | `false` |
| `--proxy <mode>` | Proxy mode: basic \| stealth \| enhanced \| auto (for geo or anti-bot pages) |  |
| `--max-age <ms>` | Reuse cached scrape up to N ms old (cheaper, near-instant) |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek scrape firecrawl` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
